items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: He started music at the same time, you know, that I did.

ctx.x: Wait a minute, I'm trying to think of another guy that's a guy. Wallace Davenport, he's played with several of the big bands from here. And then the other guy, I can't, uh, Joe, I know his name, Joe Newman.
Joe Newman, yeah, well Joe Newman, he's from here. He started music at the same time, you know, that I did. But he was in the Uptown section, I think his family was musicians.
Dwight was his father and he was a piano player.
